applicableDomain: Civil Registration & Vital Statistics (Birth Notification, WHO MCCOD Death Certification) & Mortuary Custody
descriptionAndPurpose: Links facility births to new MPI newborn identities and civil registry notifications, enforces physician WHO Medical Certificate of Cause of Death (MCCOD / ICD-11) certification, and tracks mortuary cold-chamber custody and authorized release.
prerequisiteConditions: Authoritative patientId and licensed certifying clinician credentials.
safetyChecks: Mortuary release strictly blocked without signed MCCOD certificate and authorized next-of-kin verification.
Medico-legal cases placed on mandatory hold pending coroner clearance.
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: Administrative mortuary fees never delay legally mandated MCCOD certification or CRVS notification.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Signed MCCOD certificates are immutable; corrections require formal legal addendum workflow.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: @ClinicalAudit logs certifying physician, ICD-11 underlying cause of death, custody handovers, and CRVS transmission receipt.
completionCriteria: Vital event certified and transmitted to civil registry with complete custody trail.
